checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly four text blocks separated by clear space
must.why: The date line is split into two lines ('18 September' / '2027 | 18:00–22:30'), so it reads as five lines/blocks.
Time reads 22:30 instead of 22:00, and the line is broken in two.

must.item: Fourth block exact, no other wording
must.why: 'Free entry • Everyone welcome' reads correctly; no extra words.

must.item: 4:5 portrait, dark blue background, warm lanterns, legible
must.why: Final image is 4:5 with a dark navy background, orange lanterns and legible text. The background is very dark, near black.

faults.what: End time is wrong: 22:30 instead of 22:00. A client would reject this because it gives the wrong event time.
The date/time block is split across two lines, so it looks like an extra text block and breaks the four-block requirement.
The background is nearly black rather than clearly dark blue.
The reframe cropped the lanterns, and some are cut off at the edges.

summary: The 4:5 flyer looks good, with warm lanterns and legible text, but the time reads 22:30 instead of 22:00 and the date line is split in two, so it needs a redo.
